The '''17th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1959 in film|1959 films]], were held on March 10, 1960.

==Winners and nominees==
===Film===

====[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Film - Drama]]====
''' ''[[Ben-Hur (1959 film)|Ben-Hur]]'''''
*''[[Anatomy of a Murder]]''
*''[[The Diary of Anne Frank (1959 film)|The Diary of Anne Frank]]''
*''[[The Nun's Story (film)|The Nun's Story]]''
*''[[On the Beach (1959 film)|On the Beach]]''

====[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy|Best Film - Comedy]]====
''' ''[[Some Like It Hot]]'''''
*''[[But Not for Me (1959 film)|But Not For Me]]''
*''[[Operation Petticoat]]''
*''[[Pillow Talk (film)|Pillow Talk]]''
*''[[Who Was That Lady?]]''

''' ''[[Porgy and Bess (film)|Porgy and Bess]]'''''

*''[[Li'l Abner (1959 film)|Li'l Abner]]''
*''[[Say One for Me]]''
*''[[A Private's Affair]]''
